sn4.18:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā magadhesu viharati pañcasālāyaṃ brāhmaṇagāme.
sn4.18:1.2: tena kho pana samayena pañcasālāyaṃ brāhmaṇagāme kumārakānaṃ pāhuṇakāni bhavanti.
sn4.18:1.3: atha kho bhagavā pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya pañcasālaṃ brāhmaṇagāmaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
sn4.18:1.4: tena kho pana samayena pañcasāleyyakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā mārena pāpimatā anvāviṭṭhā bhavanti
sn4.18:2.1: atha kho bhagavā yathādhotena pattena pañcasālaṃ brāhmaṇagāmaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi. tathādhotena pattena paṭikkami.
sn4.18:2.2: atha kho māro pāpimā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn4.18:2.4: tathā nu tvaṃ pāpima akāsi, yathā’haṃ piṇḍaṃ na labheyyanti.
sn4.18:2.5: tena hi bhante bhagavā dutiyampi pañcasālaṃ brāhmaṇagāmaṃ pavisatu.
sn4.18:2.6: tathā’haṃ karissāmi, yathā bhagavā piṇḍaṃ lacchatīti.
